ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A $5 \times 5$ square is divided into 25 cells. Initially all its cells are white, as shown. Neighbouring cells are those that share a common edge. On each move two neighbouring cells have their colours changed to the opposite colour (white cells become black and black ones become white). <image1>
What is the minimum number of moves required in order to obtain the chess-like colouring shown on the right?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a 5 by 5 grid on the left with all 25 cells white, an arrow, and on the right a 5 by 5 chess-like grid. In the right grid the upper-left cell is white, and the black cells alternate: (1,2), (1,4), (2,1), (2,3), (2,5), (3,2), (3,4), (4,1), (4,3), (4,5), (5,2), (5,4). Reasoning: A move toggles two cells sharing an edge. In the target checkerboard, any two edge-neighbouring cells consist of one target-black cell and one target-white cell. Therefore every move toggles exactly one of the 12 target-black cells. Each target-black cell starts white and must end black, so each must be toggled an odd number of times, hence at least once. Thus at least 12 moves are needed. This lower bound is attainable by pairing target-black cells through a shared target-white neighbour: toggle (1,2) and (1,3), then (1,4) and (1,3); toggle (2,1) and (2,2), then (2,3) and (2,2); toggle (2,5) and (3,5), then (4,5) and (3,5); toggle (3,2) and (3,3), then (3,4) and (3,3); toggle (4,1) and (4,2), then (4,3) and (4,2); toggle (5,2) and (5,3), then (5,4) and (5,3). These 12 moves toggle every required black cell once and each intermediate white cell twice, so the target colouring is obtained.

Since every pair of edge-neighbouring cells in the target checkerboard consists of one target-black cell and one target-white cell, every move toggles exactly one of the 12 target-black cells. For achievability, pair the 12 target-black cells through shared white neighbours and use two moves per pair, toggling the shared white twice: pair (1,2)-(1,4) via (1,3), (2,1)-(2,3) via (2,2), (2,5)-(4,5) via (3,5), (3,2)-(3,4) via (3,3), (4,1)-(4,3) via (4,2), and (5,2)-(5,4) via (5,3). This gives 6 pairs times 2 moves = 12 moves, matching the lower bound.

method.method_draft: Model the grid as a graph whose vertices are the 25 cells and whose edges join neighbouring cells. From the image, identify the target set T as the 12 black cells of the right-hand checkerboard, with the upper-left cell white. A sequence of moves is equivalent to choosing a multiset of graph edges; a cell finishes black exactly when its vertex is incident to an odd number of chosen edges. Thus the problem is to find the smallest T-join: choose as few grid edges as possible so that exactly the vertices in T have odd degree. Because the target checkerboard colours are opposite across every grid edge, each chosen edge has exactly one endpoint in T. Therefore the total number of chosen edges is at least the sum of the required minimum odd degrees over the 12 vertices of T, so at least 12 edges/moves are needed. To show equality, pair the vertices of T by six length-2 paths through white vertices: for example horizontally in rows 1, 3, and 5, horizontally for (2,1)-(2,3) and (4,1)-(4,3), and vertically for (2,5)-(4,5). Taking all edges in these six paths gives 12 chosen edges; every T-vertex has degree 1 and each intermediate white vertex has degree 2, while all other white vertices have degree 0. Hence the minimum is 12.
method.CoT_raw:
图像显示左边是一个 5×5 方格，所有格子都是白色；右边目标图案是 5×5 棋盘式染色，并且左上角格子是白色。因此目标黑格共有 12 个：第1、3、5行各有第2、4列为黑格，第2、4行各有第1、3、5列为黑格。

把 25 个格子看成图的顶点，相邻格子之间连一条边。一次操作就是选择一条边，并把这条边两端的两个格子颜色翻转。若某格子最终为黑色，则它必须被翻转奇数次；若最终为白色，则它必须被翻转偶数次。

设 T 为目标图案中的 12 个黑格。问题等价于：选择尽可能少的相邻边，使得恰好 T 中的顶点度数为奇数，其余顶点度数为偶数。

由于右图是棋盘式染色，任意一对相邻格子颜色相反，所以每条被选择的边都恰好连接一个黑格目标顶点和一个白格目标顶点。因此，每选择一条边，只能给 T 中贡献 1 个度数。T 中每个顶点最终都必须是奇度数，至少需要度数 1，所以选择的边数至少为 12。于是至少需要 12 步。

下面构造 12 步达到目标。把 12 个黑格两两配对，用长度为 2 的路径连接，每条路径中间经过一个白格：第1、3、5行分别连接 (1,2)-(1,4)、(3,2)-(3,4)、(5,2)-(5,4)；第2行连接 (2,1)-(2,3)，第4行连接 (4,1)-(4,3)；再竖直连接 (2,5)-(4,5)。每条长度为 2 的路径需要选择 2 条边，共 6 条路径，所以一共 12 条边。

这些路径使每个目标黑格被翻转 1 次，中间白格被翻转 2 次，其他白格被翻转 0 次，因此最终正好得到右图棋盘式染色。所以下界 12 可以达到，最少步数为 12。

Reasoning: A move toggles two cells sharing an edge. In the target checkerboard, any two edge-neighbouring cells consist of one target-black cell and one target-white cell. Therefore every move toggles exactly one of the 12 target-black cells. Each target-black cell starts white and must end black, so each must be toggled an odd number of times, hence at least once. Thus at least 12 moves are needed. This lower bound is attainable by pairing target-black cells through a shared target-white neighbour: toggle (1,2) and (1,3), then (1,4) and (1,3); toggle (2,1) and (2,2), then (2,3) and (2,2); toggle (2,5) and (3,5), then (4,5) and (3,5); toggle (3,2) and (3,3), then (3,4) and (3,3); toggle (4,1) and (4,2), then (4,3) and (4,2); toggle (5,2) and (5,3), then (5,4) and (5,3). These 12 moves toggle every required black cell once and each intermediate white cell twice, so the target colouring is obtained.
